Applied system / career transition

An evidence-led job search system.

A coordinated set of personas and quality gates for defining a search, interpreting a role, writing applications that work for both ATS and humans, and learning from every submission.

The system in one view

The candidate remains the source of truth. Specialist lenses help interpret the opportunity, shape the materials, and review quality without inventing experience or flattening the candidate’s voice.

Recommended coordination model

One primary job-seeker persona + specialist review personas + a job-search orchestrator that keeps evidence, decisions, and revisions coherent.

01 / DEFINEDefine targetSet role, level, market, constraints, and acceptable adjacencies.
02 / ALIGNAnalyze roleTranslate the job description into outcomes, capabilities, and signals.
03 / WRITEMap and draftConnect requirements to evidence, then draft the application packet.
04 / LEARNReview and learnRun quality gates, submit, and update the search from useful feedback.

The supporting personas

These are distinct lenses because their quality criteria differ. The system can start with a small team and add the rest as the search becomes more complex.

Primary / source of truth

Job seeker

Defines goals, constraints, experience, preferences, evidence, and authentic voice.

  • Target roles and boundaries
  • Outcomes, artifacts, and examples
  • Voice, gaps, and non-negotiables
Strategy

Search strategist

Turns a broad job search into a prioritized, realistic market approach.

  • Role and company targets
  • Search channels and sequencing
  • Positioning and tradeoffs
Interpretation

Hiring manager

Calibrates what the employer actually values and what success would look like.

  • Must-have versus noise
  • Level and scope signals
  • Evidence a reviewer would trust
Technical review

ATS application specialist

Checks whether the application is parsable, aligned, and truthful.

  • Structure and extraction
  • Natural terminology coverage
  • Dates, titles, and clarity
Human review

Narrative editor

Shapes clarity, relevance, credibility, voice, and persuasive flow for people.

  • Specific contribution
  • Readable story and evidence
  • Cover letter usefulness
Visual review

Visual communication reviewer

Checks hierarchy, aesthetics, portfolio presentation, and context-appropriate polish.

  • Scan path and density
  • Medium and industry fit
  • Design supporting meaning
Research

Research analyst

Finds and verifies company, team, role, and market context.

  • Dated source trail
  • Claims versus assumptions
  • Useful company signals
Conversation

Outreach and interview coach

Carries the same evidence and positioning into messages and conversations.

  • Targeted outreach
  • Evidence-led stories
  • Questions and follow-up
Coordination

Job-search orchestrator

Coordinates the lenses, preserves decisions, and keeps the search coherent over time.

  • Routes work to the right reviewer
  • Separates facts from generated language
  • Maintains the learning loop

Quality gates

ATS compatibility and human persuasion are separate gates. Visual polish is a third lens, and integrity applies across all of them.

ATS quality Technical

The system can extract and match the application without hidden formatting or inflated claims.

  • Intended sections parse correctly
  • Supported terminology appears naturally
  • Dates, titles, and outcomes are unambiguous

Human quality Persuasive

A reader can understand fit, level, contribution, and credibility quickly.

  • First scan communicates relevant value
  • Claims are specific and evidenced
  • The cover letter adds context rather than repetition

Visual quality Contextual

The document or portfolio uses hierarchy and aesthetics to support the reader’s decision path.

  • Density fits the medium and role
  • Aesthetic choices fit context and seniority
  • Portfolio visuals clarify decisions and outcomes

Integrity quality Trust

The application is persuasive because it is true, traceable, and edited against the candidate’s voice.

  • No invented metrics, tools, or outcomes
  • Gaps and uncertainty remain visible
  • Research claims are dated and sourced

Phased delivery

Start with the smallest useful loop, then add richer support only when the evidence model is stable.

Phase 0

Define the search

Capture role family, level, market, constraints, timing, and a primary target with acceptable adjacent roles.

Phase 1

Align role and evidence

Parse responsibilities and map each requirement to evidence, confidence, gaps, and follow-up questions.

Phase 2

Create the application packet

Draft the resume, application answers, cover letter when useful, and portfolio emphasis from the evidence map.

Phase 3

Review quality

Run ATS, human, visual, and integrity passes as separate reviews with explicit tradeoffs.

Phase 4+

Extend the loop

Add outreach, interview practice, submission tracking, and learning only when they can use the same evidence model.

Current boundary

The records and coordination model are now in Personas. Automatic job scraping, mass application submission, autonomous outreach, universal resume scoring, and persistent application tracking are deliberately deferred until the evidence, permissions, and quality model are strong enough.
